mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 4% triggers a tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% signals a significant contraction in aggregate demand, which depresses corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of quarters when GDPC1 falls below -2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 5.5% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation, ultimately reducing profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in INDPRO below its 12-month moving average by more than 3% for four consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate revenues and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12M MA - 3% for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower during INDPRO weakness episodes (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PAYEMS above 0.5% month-over-month and a fall in UNRATE below 4.0% signals labor market softening, which increases uncertainty and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in HOUST above 1,200 thousand units and a rise in RSAFS above 460 million dollars signals robust housing demand and consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher during these episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent low FEDFUNDS rate below 1% for more than one year, combined with a stable CPIAUCSL below 2% for six months, signals accommodative monetary policy and low inflation, which supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1% for >12 months AND CPIAUCSL < 2% for >6 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly above baseline during these episodes (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent annualized decline in GDPC1 below -1% for three consecutive quarters signals broad-based demand weakness, which reduces earnings and cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of quarters when GDPC1 is in persistent annualized decline below -1% for three quarters.
